Describe the implementation plan.

Example:

### 1. Backend
- [ ] Add the required model changes
- [ ] Add/update the API endpoint
- [ ] Add validation and error handling

### 2. Frontend
- [ ] Add the new UI component
- [ ] Connect the component to the API
- [ ] Handle loading, success and error states

### 3. Integration
- [ ] Connect the frontend and backend
- [ ] Verify authentication/permissions
- [ ] Verify backward compatibility

## Tests

<!--
Define how the feature will be validated.

Tests should verify both the expected behavior and important failure/edge cases.
For each relevant test type, explain what must be tested and why.

Consider:

- Unit tests:
  Test individual functions, classes, services, validation rules, etc.

- API tests:
  Test endpoints, request/response schemas, authentication,
  authorization, validation and error handling.

- Edge cases:
  Test invalid input, missing data, empty states, duplicates,
  permissions, concurrency, limits, failures, etc.

- Performance tests:
  Include when the feature can affect response times, resource usage,
  database queries, or scalability.

For each test, explain what behavior is being validated.
-->
